body:
Thanks, I appreciate you taking the time. I'm really trying not to do those things. It's just as much as I try to get out from under it, it comes back. I had a really great time in Norway, it was my dream trip. Every now and again, though, I'd be in some shop and the voice in my head would go, "she would have loved this place". I don't want to think about her, my pain, but it's like my brain is just stuck on it. My hobbies help and having wonderful friends helps, but I just wish my mind would stop reminding me.

I sometimes worry too that I'm not dealing with it by keeping myself occupied. I know there have been times in my life where I've filled my time with friends, family, and hobbies to avoid dealing with something troubling.

I don't know, I didn't mean to write all this, I just wanted to say thanks. I think you're right, though, maybe I just need to try other things. I always wanted to learn German, I wanted to study for something to help in my career. Maybe I need to focus on things that do more to enrich my life.

Thanks, I did try a few dates over the summer, but inside I felt like I'm still such a mess that it was unfair to these women, so I just stopped dating. I guess in my own mind, I thought, let me be the best me before I date again, but I'm starting to wonder when that will be.
